name: kartograph
description: Explore a person's intent into intents/<date>-<slug>.md, extract its concepts into an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/, derive capabilities and Gherkin features under features/, plan the implementation in three hexagonal rings for the project's technology stack, build the screens on sample data, then the domain, then the adapters, and walk the person through what was built.

interface.shortDescription: Draw out what a person really wants before anything gets built
interface.longDescription: Kartograph has eight skills that build on each other through plain files. kartograph-explore runs one exploring conversation with you and writes intents/<date>-<slug>.md. kartograph-knowledge records every concept an intent introduces in an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/. kartograph-features derives capabilities and Gherkin features under features/. kartograph-plan detects the project's technology stack (Kotlin Multiplatform today; more stacks are directories) and writes a three-ring plan: screens, domain, adapters. kartograph-screens builds ring 1 on fakes with sample data so you can walk the flow first; kartograph-domain builds the real behaviour with a test per scenario; kartograph-adapters builds repositories, database, API client, platform capabilities and the server. kartograph-walk drives the running app scenario by scenario in front of you after any ring and records your verdicts under walks/.
defaultPrompt: Explore my intent for a new feature with kartograph-explore
Plan the project-archiving capability with kartograph-plan
Build the screens for the newest plan with kartograph-screens
Walk me through the project-archiving capability with kartograph-walk
